Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: In the very first turn (Step 1), the WebSurfer agent explicitly stated in its output: "noted from the results that Earth's rotation period is approximately 365 days (one year)". This is a factual error; 365 days is Earth's orbital period (revolution around the Sun), not its rotation period. While the agent later corrected itself regarding the 24-hour day, this initial hallucination of the orbital period as the rotation period was the first mistake made in the conversation.
